# Release & Verification Gate Checklist: Equity Accumulator & Decumulator Products

**Purpose**: Validate requirement completeness, testability criteria, build definitions, and governance gates before releasing the Equity Accumulator and Decumulator features into production
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## End-to-End User Journey Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are complete acceptance criteria defined for the end-to-end Equity Accumulator user journey from document ingestion to scenario simulation? [Completeness, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK002 Are complete acceptance criteria defined for the end-to-end Equity Decumulator user journey including downside knock-out and upside 2x delivery? [Completeness, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements specified for transitioning between the clean landing page, Termsheet Details view, and the dedicated Accumulator workspace? [Completeness, Spec §US3, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK004 Are plain-language scenario narrative requirements defined for Best Case, Base Case, and Worst Case accumulator and decumulator outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK005 Are error-handling and recovery requirements defined for corrupted, unreadable, or non-accumulator termsheet uploads? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Mathematical & Engine Testability Criteria

- [ ] CHK006 Are deterministic analytical payoff formulas documented to enable automated unit testing against analytical benchmarks? [Testability, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Are quantitative tolerance thresholds defined for client-side 60fps calculation latency during real-time slider manipulation? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Are unit test requirements specified for the kinked slope transition at the 2x gearing strike price? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Are test criteria established for physical share delivery calculations vs. cash mark-to-market P&L across discrete market price points? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK010 Are test scenarios documented for guaranteed observation periods during active knock-out barrier touches? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Build, Deployment & Environment Criteria

- [ ] CHK011 Are frontend production bundle build requirements (`npm run build`, TypeScript strict type checking) documented without circular dependencies? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK012 Are backend Python testing requirements (`pytest`) and Pydantic schema validation suites explicitly specified? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK013 Are Google Cloud Run serverless deployment constraints (stateless container runtime, ephemeral memory buffers) documented and respected? [Consistency, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK014 Are environment configuration requirements for Google Gemini API credentials and model fallbacks clearly defined? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]

## Constitution & Privacy Governance Criteria

- [ ] CHK015 Are zero-retention requirements (Principle I: no disk storage, database records, or client-side persistent storage of simulated scenarios) verifiably specified? [Compliance, Constitution §I, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK016 Are counterparty data scrubbing requirements (Principle II: complete omission of bank issuer names, distribution logos, and client account coordinates) testable? [Compliance, Constitution §II, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK017 Are visual hierarchy and aesthetic standards (Principle III: curated color zones for 1x accumulation, 2x gearing, and knock-out boundary) defined with objective guidelines? [Clarity, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK018 Are Google ADK structured orchestration tool boundaries specified without ad-hoc prompt chaining? [Consistency, Constitution §IV]

## Traceability & Release Sign-Off

- [ ] CHK019 Is there 100% bidirectional traceability between each Functional Requirement (FR-001 through FR-010) and an actionable implementation task? [Traceability, Tasks §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK020 Are independent test verification steps documented for each user story phase prior to release sign-off? [Acceptance Criteria, Tasks §Implementation Strategy]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the rollback/abort protocol defined in the event that extraction confidence scores fall below acceptable thresholds? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK021) for easy reference
